name: FUJIFILM 400
notes: FUJIFILM 400 (current product), Japanese-language Product Information Bulletin (document 163AR0131A, print code 24.02-FFBX in the footer, taken as 2024-02; no other date printed), plots on page 4 (nos. 15 特性曲線, 16 分光感度曲線, 17 色素の分光濃度曲線); a scanned page (raster images, about 310-390 dpi), the curves were traced from hand-placed hints (for the characteristic-curve and dye plots the hints were then re-set on the first trace so that they sit on the curves). Sheet id fuji-400, PDF fuji-fujifilm-400.pdf. Process printed on the plots: CN-16 (the bulletin also allows CN-16X/L/S/ER and C-41). Densitometry printed as ステータスM相当 (Status M equivalent). Base: polyester 100 um (135).

Speed: daylight ISO 400/27 degrees; 3200 K tungsten ISO 100/21 degrees with filter LBB-12. The bulletin says it prints well on Fujicolor paper (フジカラーペーパー). No Log H Ref and no RMS granularity value is printed (log_h_ref and grain null).

curves: x is log H in lux-seconds as printed (daylight 1/125 s); the three solid curves 青 (blue), 緑 (green), 赤 (red) never touch (D-min plateaus about 0.88 b, 0.40 g, 0.16 r; the curves end at log H about 0.26 b, 0.35 g, 0.35 r). The last point of a line can lie up to one 0.05 step beyond the drawn end (flat extrapolation by the tool).

sensitivity: the y axis has NO numbers, only a double arrow marking 1.0 between two horizontal rules. y is therefore set to 1.0 on the upper rule and 0.0 on the lower rule: the zero is arbitrary, only differences between points and between layers are meaningful. Sensitivity = reciprocal of the exposure in J/cm2 giving density D-min + 1.0 (Status M equivalent, CN-16). The three layers are plain solid lines that cross; each ends in a steep drop (blue ends about 495 nm, green starts about 462 nm and ends about 600 nm, red starts about 558 nm and ends about 700 nm); the tool keeps one y per x, so the last few nm of the drops are approximated, and the first/last sample on the 5 nm grid can be a flat extension of up to 5 nm.

dyes: the plot (色素の分光濃度曲線) is not of separate cyan/magenta/yellow dyes but of two curves, 中間濃度 (mid-scale density, measurement example for a neutral subject; mid) and 最小濃度 (minimum density; min), 400-720 nm, y = spectral diffuse density 分光拡散濃度 as printed (0-2.5).

The sensitivity and dye-density drawings are the same as on the FUJIFILM 200 sheet (fuji-200, AF3-0261E): the traced values agree to within about 0.02 (except on the steep edges). Only the characteristic curves differ (this film is 0.03-0.06 higher in D-min and about 0.2 higher from log H -2 upward).
